title: Ingesting Multi-Model Data
purpose: Aggregates global NWP physics runs (ECMWF, GFS), AI neural models (GraphCast, AIFS), multi-model ensembles, and AWS surface station observations into a unified grid format.
processing: Spatial regridding to standard 0.1° x 0.1° WGS84 grid; temporal interpolation to 1-hour intervals.
output: Standardized Tensor Matrix (Coordinates x LeadTime x Variables x Models).
keyTech: Python xarray, cfgrib, GDAL, Apache Kafka ingestion stream

title: Analyzing Historical Model Skill
purpose: Evaluates recent 30-day and 90-day verification statistics (MAE, RMSE, CRPS, Threat Score) for each model across lead times and regional climate zones.
processing: Rolling verification metrics calculation over last 72h observations and historical climatology database.
output: Dynamic Model Skill Vectors (S_nwpa, S_nwpb, S_ai, S_ens).
keyTech: SciPy stats, Polars, DuckDB analytics engine

title: Detecting Weather Regime
purpose: Classifies the current atmospheric state into distinct synoptic regimes (e.g. Monsoon Trough, Heavy Convective, Heat Dome, High Wind, Extreme Anomaly).
processing: K-Means + XGBoost Classifier trained on 40 years of ERA5 reanalysis weather regimes.
output: Current Weather Regime Classification & Probability Vector (P_regime = 87% Heavy Rainfall).
keyTech: XGBoost, Scikit-learn, ERA5 Reanalysis Training Pipeline

title: Calculating Dynamic Weights
purpose: Assigns contextual weights to each model dynamically based on skill, regime fit, season, region, and lead time.
processing: Bayesian Softmax Weighting Function: W_i = Softmax( α*Skill_i + β*RegimeFit_i + γ*RecentPerf_i ).
output: Normalized Dynamic Model Weights (NWP-A: 39%, NWP-B: 22%, AI: 24%, Ensemble: 15%).
keyTech: PyTorch tensor operations, Bayesian Updating Engine

title: AI + NWP Blending Engine
purpose: Executes weighted spatial-temporal fusion of numerical physics grids and deep learning neural predictions.
processing: Convex combination matrix multiplication with spatial smoothing filter across boundary grids.
output: Raw Blended Forecast Grid (Rainfall, Temp, Wind, Humidity, Pressure).

title: Quantile-Based Bias Correction
purpose: Corrects systematic over-estimation or under-estimation in extreme precipitation and peak temperature values.
processing: Empirical Quantile Mapping (EQM) and elevation-lapse-rate local temperature adjustment.

title: Physics-Informed Validation
purpose: Verifies thermodynamic and hydro-dynamic physical law constraints to prevent unrealistic AI model outputs (hallucinations).
processing: Mass conservation check, hydrostatic equilibrium constraint, dewpoint non-exceedance test, wind continuity solver.
output: Physics Validation Pass Matrix (or Anomaly Flag if unphysical).
keyTech: Custom Physics Ruleset, Conservation Law Solvers

title: Confidence & Spread Estimation
purpose: Computes spatial variance, inter-model agreement percentage, and prediction uncertainty bounds.
processing: Inter-model standard deviation analysis and ensemble spread entropy calculation.
output: Forecast Confidence Index (88%) & Upper/Lower Uncertainty Bounds.

title: Extreme Weather Check & Warning Dispatch
purpose: Evaluates blended values against regional hazard thresholds (IMD Heavy Rainfall / Heat Wave criteria) to generate early warnings.
processing: Threshold rule engine & risk matrix evaluation (WATCH, ADVISORY, HIGH RISK, EXTREME).
output: Final ForecastBridge Intelligence Package & Disaster Alert GeoJSON.
